image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage-style comic book cover. The cover features bold, stylized typography in black and red against a yellow background. A central illustration depicts a character with green skin and a distressed expression, rendered in a rough, inked style typical of underground comix or horror comics. There are speech bubbles and text blocks, though the text appears largely illegible or gibberish. The paper texture suggests age, with some wear visible.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the image, specifically in the title block and speech bubbles/caption areas.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is a hallmark AI artifact. It mimics the shape and density of letters but forms no recognizable words or characters in any standard language. This is a severe failure in rendering functional text, which is a key component of the 'comic book' class.

artifact_observations.location: Edges of the character illustration and text blocks.
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is slight bleeding and softness at the boundaries between the inked lines and the colored backgrounds, lacking the crisp edge definition of high-quality print scanning. The 'ink' looks slightly digital/painted rather than physically printed.
The hands clutching the head are indistinct and malformed. Fingers merge into each other and the head without clear anatomical separation, a common AI generation issue with complex limb poses.
